search_order: repository-local Lean bodies, wrappers, legacy artifacts, and same-claim theorem dossiers
all locally materialized packages in the pinned Lake closure, including pinned mathlib
theorem-specific public Lean 4 projects at immutable revisions
other public Lean 4 repositories through bounded code and repository indexes
historical formal-system and human-source leads as non-Lean completion evidence
repositories_and_registries: this repository at the recorded base revision and tree
leanprover-community/mathlib4 and every package in Formalizations/Lean/lake-manifest.json at its recorded revision
Sourcegraph public indexed Lean repositories with archived repositories and forks included
GitHub public repository and code search using unauthenticated HTTPS
google-deepmind/formal-conjectures through an existing content-bound repository-local audit of its immutable tree
aliases: rational points on curves over number fields
api_and_command_forms: rg and rg --files over repository-local and pinned Lean sources
git rev-parse, status, show, and grep over already materialized immutable Git objects
lake env lean over target-owned statement and anchor probes
Sourcegraph search stream with lang:Lean, archived:yes, fork:yes, count:100, and bounded timeouts
GitHub REST repository and code search through anonymous HTTPS
GitHub raw immutable commit URLs for candidate source, toolchain, manifest, and license files

immutable_ref_rules.repo_local: The recorded repository commit/tree and tracked Git blobs bind discovery inputs; worker additions are explicitly nonrelease evidence.
immutable_ref_rules.mathlib: The existing lake-manifest commit and package tree are used read-only without update, build, fetch, clone, or checkout.
immutable_ref_rules.external: Candidate source credit requires a 40-hex commit, immutable raw URL, and content digest; a moving branch or search hit supplies no proof credit.
immutable_ref_rules.search_responses: Dated response hashes bind only each bounded observation and do not establish global absence or proof-source identity.
immutable_ref_rules.human_sources: Bibliographic metadata supplies no H0 credit without an exact locator, assumption map, correction review, and independent acceptance.

credentials_policy: Unauthenticated public endpoints only. Authentication failure, rate limiting, timeout, truncation, or index omission is an access limitation, never a zero-result claim.
expected_negative_evidence: Retain each query, source scope, completion status, match count, response digest where available, and every access limitation. A zero result is local to that immutable tree or dated index response.
classification_policy: Compare every candidate with the literal frozen Lean expression and mathematical scope. Definitions or statement surfaces are M3 at best. M1 requires credible immutable kernel closure. A direct or transitive proof gap, disallowed trust boundary, or material statement mismatch is M5. M0 requires exact repo-local integration and accepted evidence.
credit_boundary: This protocol supports a bounded immutable formal-anchor inventory only. It cannot supply H0, R0, a proof of FaltingsTarget, M1/M0, AUDIT-Z, theorem completion, release, or master acceptance.
